info.title: Astra independently authored DEMO API
info.description: Independently authored DEMO contracts for all 47 services. These are not reference-site server contracts. Mutation routes require session and CSRF except public signup/login/support subscriptions and signed sandbox webhook. Real identity, legal issuance and commercial payment providers are not configured.

post.description: Citizen own/staff/admin tenant only; same service/citizen/tenant DB-enforced. All47 services allowed. One active successor per source; canceled/rejected successor allows replacement. Trade previous number is server pinned. Revoked source blocks issue; renewed document needs normal review/approval and one new charge.
